title: Bottle Turns Slowly in Place
tests: Tests actual product rotation from a source photo rather than a camera orbit, with stable product geometry and surroundings.

faults.what: A large white wordmark rotates into view, adding prominent branding that is not established by the reference image.
The supplied audio report includes speech, so the video is not silent as explicitly requested.
The cap loop changes shape inconsistently during the turn, and the bottle becomes slightly narrower and shifts left rather than remaining completely rigid and centered.
The reported duration is 6.6 seconds rather than the requested 6 seconds.

judge.summary: The recognizable black bottle turns slowly in a stable square shot, but added branding, slight shape drift, and unwanted audio require correction.

must_haves.item: The matte black insulated bottle from the attachment remains recognizable throughout.
must_haves.why: The black finish, tall cylindrical body, shoulder profile, and looped cap remain recognizable in all supplied frames.

must_haves.item: The bottle visibly turns slowly through roughly a quarter turn, rather than merely sliding or enlarging.
must_haves.why: The changing cap orientation and lettering moving from the right edge toward the front show a gradual substantial rotation consistent with roughly a quarter turn.

must_haves.item: The bottle stays upright on the table without melting, bending or changing its proportions.
must_haves.why: It stays upright and grounded, but its width and cap-loop geometry change slightly across the frames.

must_haves.item: The camera and wooden table remain stationary.
must_haves.why: The table edges, wood grain, windows, and background furniture remain substantially aligned.

must_haves.item: The output is a square, silent video lasting approximately 6 seconds.
must_haves.why: The frames are square and the 6.6-second duration is approximately six seconds, but the supplied sound report identifies speech rather than silence.
